description: Sartorius winds from the front hip across the thigh like a ribbon, steering the leg into seated and crossed-legged poses artists love to study.
actions: Flexes the hip while abducting and laterally rotating the thigh to initiate tailor-style sitting.
Assists knee flexion and medial rotation when the leg is unweighted, aiding graceful transitions.
Stabilizes the pelvis and knee along the medial thigh during poised standing poses.
